mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.NAME, M.DEPARTMENT, M.PASSWORD, M.STATUS, M.FAIL_COUNT, M.PWD_CHG_DATE, M.LAST_LONG_DATE, M.REG_DATE, M.PHONE, M.EMAIL, M.PICTURE, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER_ROLE MR WHERE MR.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND MR.ROLE_CODE = 'ROLE_ADMIN') THEN 'ROLE_ADMIN' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER_ROLE MR WHERE MR.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND MR.ROLE_CODE = 'ROLE_USER') THEN 'ROLE_USER' ELSE 'ROLE_GUEST' END AS ROLE_CODE FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, NAME, DEPARTMENT, PASSWORD, STATUS, FAIL_COUNT, PWD_CHG_DATE, LAST_LONG_DATE, REG_DATE, PHONE, EMAIL, PICTURE ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{name}, #{department}, #{password}, '0', 0, SYSDATE, NULL, SYSDATE, #{phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email}, #{picture} )
